g.text: Runs at the end of every turn, after the manager's choices.
Inside a loop, customer is each customer of the game in turn. Elsewhere it is
the customer named in the message: the payer, or a customer who leaves.
order is that customer's order and table is the table they sit at.
EATING and served on an earlier turn: becomes READY_TO_PAY
oldest first: the earliest READY_TO_PAY customer, or null
abstract in Customer, so the subclass decides:
